tools.name: taiga_whoami
tools.description: Show the authenticated Taiga user and the projects they can access. Use this to verify the connection and to discover project slugs.

tools.name: taiga_project_list
tools.description: List the Taiga projects the current user is a member of. If TAIGA_PROJECT is set, every other tool defaults to it.

fields.description: Detail level: 'slim' (default), 'full', or a list of field names.

tools.name: taiga_project_get
tools.description: Get one Taiga project by id or slug.

fields.description: Detail level: 'slim' (default), 'full', or a list of field names.

tools.name: taiga_project_schema
tools.description: List the valid statuses, priorities, severities, issue types, points, roles, members and custom fields of a project. Members include their username and role in the project. Use it to show the user what values are allowed; you do not need it before writing, because status and person names are resolved automatically.

tools.name: taiga_userstory_list
tools.description: List user story items in a Taiga project. Returns a slim projection by default. For name lookup use taiga_search.

in_backlog.description: Only stories not assigned to any sprint.

tags.description: Stories carrying any of these tags.

fields.description: Detail level: 'slim' (default), 'full', or a list of field names.

tools.name: taiga_userstory_get
tools.description: Get one user story by its #ref number or internal id.

fields.description: Detail level: 'slim' (default), 'full', or a list of field names.

tools.name: taiga_userstory_create
tools.description: Create a user story. Status and assignee are given by name, not by id.

status.description: Status name; defaults to the project's first status.

points.description: Points per role (preferred), e.g. {"Front":"5","Back":"3"}. A bare "5" goes to the project's first role by order — Taiga has no single "primary" role.

epic.description: Epic subject to link this story to; empty string unlinks it.

tools.name: taiga_userstory_update
tools.description: Update a user story. Only the fields you pass are changed; the current version is read and sent automatically. Use append_description and add_tags to add without overwriting.

points.description: Points per role (preferred), e.g. {"Front":"5","Back":"3"}. A bare "5" goes to the project's first role by order — Taiga has no single "primary" role.

epic.description: Epic subject to link this story to; empty string unlinks it.

backlog_order.description: Position in the backlog; lower comes first.

assigned_users.description: Full names of everyone assigned; replaces the list, [] clears it.

append_description.description: Text to append to the existing description.

add_tags.description: Tags to add, keeping the existing ones.

tools.name: taiga_userstory_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a user story. Requires confirm: true. Ask the user before calling this.

confirm.description: Must be true. Guards against accidental deletion.

tools.name: taiga_comment_list
tools.description: List the comments on a user story, task, issue or epic, oldest first.

resource.description: Which kind of item the comment belongs to.

tools.name: taiga_comment_add
tools.description: Add a comment to a user story, task, issue or epic.

resource.description: Which kind of item the comment belongs to.

tools.name: taiga_search
tools.description: Full-text search across a project's user stories, tasks, issues, epics and wiki pages. Use it when you know roughly what an item is called but not its #ref. For a full listing use taiga_<resource>_list. Returns only the fields Taiga actually sent back; use taiga_*_get for the rest.

tools.name: taiga_bulk_create
tools.description: Create up to 50 user stories, tasks or issues in one call. Each item is created independently: a failure in one does not stop the rest. Show the user the plan before calling this.

items.description: Items to create. Each takes the same fields as the matching taiga_<resource>_create tool, e.g. {subject, description, status, tags}.

tools.name: taiga_stats
tools.description: Progress statistics. With `sprint` it returns that sprint's points, completed work, a day-by-day burndown series and per-person load. Without it, project-wide totals and velocity.

sprint.description: Sprint name, e.g. 'Sprint 2'. Omit for project-wide stats.

resource.description: Which kind of item the attachment belongs to.

tools.description: Attach a local file to a user story, task, issue or epic.

resource.description: Which kind of item the attachment belongs to.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to upload.

tools.name: taiga_attachment_download
tools.description: Download an attachment to a local directory. Get the id from taiga_attachment_list.

resource.description: Which kind of item the attachment belongs to.

target_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory to save into.

tools.name: taiga_link
tools.description: Link two records: blocks — the first blocks the second; relates — just related, and writes nothing if the project has no «Связано с» field. remove undoes the link.
